signals.title: Witkoppen Road at the Braamfontein Spruit bridge, Paulshof/Fourways (approx.): car swept away by floodwater, driver rescued from a tree, 25 Nov
signals.content: A motorist's vehicle was swept away by floodwater at the Braamfontein Spruit bridge on Witkoppen Road, near Achter Road, in the Paulshof/Fourways area of Johannesburg on Wednesday 25 November, during heavy rain under a SAWS yellow level 4 warning. City of Johannesburg EMS spokesperson Robert Mulaudzi said the EMS aquatic rescue unit rescued the person, who had been trapped when the vehicle was washed away (SABC News, 25 Nov). The Fourways Review quotes the Sandton Community Policing Forum: one person was in the car, he escaped, clung to a tree and was helped to safety; EMS said he was rescued unharmed. The pin is approximate: the Witkoppen and Achter roads area, not a surveyed bridge point.

checked.incident: Wed 25 Nov 2026, evening, before 20:10 (SABC News report time); heavy rain began that afternoon.
checked.location: APPROX. Braamfontein Spruit bridge on Witkoppen Road at Achter Road (Fourways Review); Witkoppen Road, Fourways (SABC News). Point placed where Witkoppen Road meets Achter Road (Nominatim: Achter Road, Paulshof, -26.0330, 28.0579; Witkoppen Road segment -26.0374, 28.0589). Overpass was at capacity, so the bridge itself was not looked up. Street level, about 400 m.

signals.title: Nasrec Road, Riverlea (approx.): road collapses after heavy rain, closed between Main Reef Road and Dunlin Drive, 25 Nov
signals.content: Road infrastructure on Nasrec Road in Riverlea, Johannesburg, collapsed on Wednesday 25 November after heavy rain, leaving a large hole, The Bulrushes reports. JMPD spokesperson Superintendent Xolani Fihla said the Johannesburg Roads Agency had closed Nasrec Road between Main Reef Road and Dunlin Drive and that it will stay closed until JRA engineers have assessed and repaired the damage; northbound traffic is blocked at Dunlin Drive, and detours are Crownwood Road, New Canada Road, Colorado Drive and Avon Street. South African Daily carries the same JMPD account. No injuries were reported in either report. The pin is approximate: the Nasrec Road point near Dunlin Drive, not the collapse itself, which the reports do not place more exactly.

signals.title: Dobsonville, Soweto (map point estimated): girl, 11, swept away by flash floodwater after school transport drop-off, 17 Nov; body recovered 20 Nov
signals.content: An 11-year-old girl was swept away by fast-flowing floodwater on the afternoon of Tuesday 17 November in Dobsonville, Soweto, during heavy rain and thunderstorms, shortly after her school transport dropped her off, the Mail & Guardian and IOL report. IOL places the drop-off in Snake Park, near Dobsonville Extension 3. Joburg EMS, the SAPS Water Wing and K9 Unit, police divers, private security, City Parks workers and residents searched the stream; her body was recovered on Friday 20 November not far from where she was last seen, the Mail & Guardian reports, and her family identified her. Gauteng CoGTA MEC Jacob Mamabolo was at the scene. The child is not named here. The map point is estimated: the Dobsonville suburb point, not the stream.
